headline: Inflation in July is 2.3 percent, Macedonia is second in the region, says Mickoski
summary: Inflation in North Macedonia stood at 2.3% year on year in July, while market retail prices rose 1.8%, placing the country second-lowest in the region, according to Prime Minister Christian Mickoski.
why: Inflation data guides the National Bank of North Macedonia's policy decisions and affects the country's bond and currency markets.
